annotation.title_clean: 关于“十五五”期间支持科普事业发展进口税收优惠政策管理办法的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on the Administrative Measures for the Import Tax Preferential Policy Supporting the Development of Science Popularization during the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 财政部; 中央宣传部; 科技部; 工业和信息化部; 海关总署; 税务总局; 广电总局
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry notice (Cai Guan Shui [2026] No. 13) setting administrative measures for import tax exemptions for science popularization venues during 2026–2030, covering eligibility lists, duty-free imports, refunds, annual review and enforcement. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Science and technology authorities approve lists of eligible science popularization venues.
Duty-free imports include self-use science films and equipment not producible domestically.
First batch of lists applies retroactively from 1 January 2026, with refunds of duties already paid.
Eligibility is reviewed annually; ineligible entities lose the exemption.
Policy runs from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2030.
